what_it_does: Presents HELM, a system for improving GPU performance when unified memory (shared memory space between CPU and GPU) runs out of physical capacity and must swap data between high-capacity main memory and GPU memory. HELM measures and characterizes how software accesses unified memory by observing device driver telemetry (low-level communication logs). Based on these access patterns, it automatically selects the best data migration strategy to prevent severe performance slowdowns that occur with default policies.
